spec_match.rationale: Classifies ws:// targets into the three LNA address spaces with the exact CIDR reasoning (127/8, ::1, RFC1918 ranges, link-local, the localhost name rule) and maps each to the targetAddressSpace value a connection needs.

interactive.rationale: Editable host list plus a classify button; verified the default eleven hosts produce 3 loopback / 4 local / 2 public / 2 undecidable with per-row reasons.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises classification with the not-actually-local surprises, and 172.32.4.9 delivers exactly that lesson.

edge_cases.rationale: The 172.16/12 near-miss, IPv6 loopback, link-local, .local names and DNS-undecidable hosts are all in the default list with honest 'unknown' verdicts.

conformance.rationale: The suite covers the constructor/enum contracts this page's values column references; on Chromium 141 it honestly ran 2 pass / 3 fail since the option needs Chrome 154.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp): classification ran live with correct tallies and per-row reasoning; console clean, desktop and mobile screenshots read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Loads demo-telemetry.js and logs the classification tally.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, captioned table, no static card.

accessibility.rationale: Labelled textarea, captioned table with scoped headers, aria-live detail, 44px button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 (scrollWidth 360, screenshot read).

summary: Reviewed at http://localhost:3000/v154/support-targetaddressspace-option-for-websockets/address-spaces/ with Chromium 141 headless (cloud, no chrome-devtools-mcp). The classifier is accurate at the edges that matter — the 172.32 near-miss, link-local as local, hostnames as undecidable-until-DNS — and ties each verdict to the targetAddressSpace value a connection would declare. Console/network clean bar the sandbox font-CDN artifact; no mobile overflow; feature /conformance/ honestly ran 2 pass / 3 fail on this pre-154 build. Clears the bar.
